summary_en: 2,500,000 shares (9.50% of shares outstanding) | ¥5,500,000,000 upper limit | ToSTNeT-3 execution | settlement 2026-06-09 | price ceiling ¥2,200/share | results published after 08:45 JST trade close
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and share acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading
translation_en_brief: On 8 June 2026, Nagase's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 2,500,000 treasury shares (9.50% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate price of ¥5,500,000,000 under the Companies Act. The purchase will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 9 June 2026 at 08:45 JST, with a price ceiling of ¥2,200 per share (the closing price on 8 June). The order is valid only during the specified trading window. Results will be disclosed after the 08:45 trading close. The company stated the acquisition enables flexible capital-policy execution in response to changing business conditions, pursuant to the articles of incorporation. Execution is not guaranteed and may be partially or fully cancelled depending on market conditions.
